# Historical risk evaluation

P90/P95 were fitted only on final development observations.
Events use >= for actual and prediction. Equal P90/P95 has no Warning band.
No operator congestion labels are available; these are statistical exceedances.
Counts, exclusions and undefined denominator flags are in risk_holdout.csv; load groups use development-only tiers.
Examples below are the first three available FP/FN per horizon and scenario, without cherry-picking.
